Direction of a goal and the deviation it penalizes

Source: R/build_lp.R
direction_type.Rd

">=" (the goal is a floor) penalizes d-; "<=" (a ceiling) penalizes d+; "=" penalizes both.

Usage

direction_type(direction)

Arguments

direction

">=", "<=" or "=".

Value

"minus", "plus" or "both".

Examples

direction_type(c(">=", "<=", "="))
#> [1] "minus" "plus"  "both"
